exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KUNDALIK IShLAR - FE'L VA OT BIRIKMASI.

  ⚠ Bu - COLLOCATION mashqi: inglizchada
  qaysi fe'l qaysi ot bilan yuradi.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada bitta fe'l ('qilmoq')
  ko'p narsaga to'g'ri keladi, inglizchada
  esa har ot O'Z fe'lini talab qiladi.


⚠ ENG QIYIN UChTASI - 'DO', 'MAKE',
'HAVE':

  DO - ish, vazifa, uy yumushi
     do homework, do the washing-up,
     do the ironing, do the housework,
     do the shopping

  MAKE - biror narsa YaRATISh
     make a cake, make a mistake,
     make a noise, make friends

  HAVE - ovqat, tajriba, mashg'ulot
     have breakfast, have a shower,
     have a lesson, have a good time

  ⚠ 'do a mistake' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'make homework' - XATO.


⚠ 'GO' + -ING (mashg'ulotlar):

  go shopping, go dancing, go fishing,
  go swimming, go hiking, go skiing

  ⚠ Lekin 'go TO bed' - bu -ING emas,
  chunki 'bed' OT.
  ⚠ 'go to bed' da artikl YO'Q!


⚠ 'LISTEN TO' - PREDLOG ShART:

  'listen TO music' ✓
  'listen music' ✗

  ⚠ Lekin 'watch TV' - predlogsiz.
  ⚠ 'hear' bilan ham predlog yo'q:
  'I hear a noise.'


⚠ 'RIDE' va 'DRIVE':

  ride - ustiga MINIB boshqariladigan
     narsa: a bicycle, a motorbike,
     a horse
  drive - IChIGA kirib boshqariladigan
     narsa: a car, a bus, a lorry


⚠ 'WASH' va 'WASH UP':

  wash - yuvmoq (kir, mashina, yuz)
  do the washing-up - IDISh yuvmoq

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'do the washing-up',
  AQShda 'do the dishes'.
  ⚠ 9-bandda 'the dishes' bilan 'wash'
  ham ishlatilgan - ikkalasi to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Use phrases from Ex. 1a and say two things you: 1 ... do every day. 2 ... do every weekend. 3 ... don't like doing. 4 ... hate doing. 5 ... don't mind doing. 6 ... like doing.
exercises.instructionUz: 1a mashqidagi iboralardan foydalanib, o'zingiz haqingizda ikkitadan narsa ayting: 1 ... har kuni qiladiganingiz. 2 ... har dam olish kunida qiladiganingiz. 3 ... yoqtirmaydiganingiz. 4 ... yomon ko'radiganingiz. 5 ... qarshi bo'lmaganingiz. 6 ... yoqtiradiganingiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
YOQTIRISh VA YOQTIRMASLIK.

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA: bu fe'llardan
  keyin HAR DOIM -ING shakli keladi.

     like       + -ING
     don't like + -ING
     hate       + -ING
     don't mind + -ING
     enjoy      + -ING
     love       + -ING

  ⚠ 'I hate to do' ham uchraydi, lekin
  -ING tabiiyroq va kitob shuni
  so'rayapti.


⚠ KUChLILIK DARAJASI (kuchsizdan
kuchliga):

  hate          - yomon ko'raman
  don't like    - yoqtirmayman
  don't mind    - qarshi emasman
  like          - yoqtiraman
  love          - juda yaxshi ko'raman

  ⚠ 'don't mind' - o'rtada turadi:
  yoqmaydi ham, yoqadi ham emas -
  ParVO QILMAYMAN.


⚠ 'DON'T MIND' - DIQQAT:

  'I don't mind doing the washing-up.'
  = Idish yuvishga qarshi emasman.

  ⚠ 'Do you mind ...?' esa MULOYIM
  ILTIMOS: 'Do you mind closing the
  window?' = Derazani yopsangiz
  bo'ladimi?
  ⚠ Bunga javob: 'No, not at all.'
  ('No' - ROZILIK bildiradi!)


⚠ 'EVERY DAY' - AJRATIB YOZILADI:

  'I do it every day.' (ravish)
  ⚠ 'everyday' (birga) = SIFAT.

exercises.instructionUz: a) Suratlarga va maqola sarlavhasiga qarang. Somon yo'li nima? b) Qaysi surat nimani ko'rsatadi: orbitadagi kosmik kema; 'kosmik sayr'; sun'iy yo'ldosh; bir-biriga yordam berayotgan kosmonavtlar; kemadagi ekipaj? c) Kosmonavtlar orbitada har kuni nima qiladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNI O'QIShDAN OLDIN TAXMIN QILISh.

  ⚠ Bu 'predicting' - o'qish ko'nikmasining
  muhim qismi: suratlarga va sarlavhaga
  qarab matn nima haqida ekanini
  oldindan bilish.


⚠ 'THE MILKY WAY':

  = SOMON YO'LI - bizning galaktikamiz.

  ⚠ So'zma-so'z: 'sutli yo'l'.
  Qadimgi yunon afsonasiga ko'ra bu -
  osmonga to'kilgan sut.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada 'Somon yo'li' (somon
  sochilgan yo'l).

  ⚠ HAR DOIM 'THE' bilan va KATTA
  harf bilan yoziladi.


SURATLAR:
  A - kosmik kema (space shuttle)
  B - kabinadagi ikki kosmonavt
  C - sun'iy yo'ldosh (satellite)
  D - ochiq kosmosdagi kosmonavt
  E - (13-betda) kemaning manipulyator
      qo'li yonidagi kosmonavt


⚠ KOSMIK SO'ZLAR:

  a space shuttle - qayta ishlatiladigan
     kosmik kema
  orbit - orbita ('IN orbit' - artiklsiz!)
  a space walk - ochiq kosmosga chiqish
  a satellite - sun'iy yo'ldosh
  a spaceship - kosmik kema
  a crew - ekipaj
  aboard - bort ustida
  Mission Control - uchish boshqaruv
     markazi

  ⚠ 'IN ORBIT' - artiklsiz turg'un ibora.
  ⚠ 'ABOARD a spaceship' - 'on board'
  ning qisqa shakli.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR 13-BETDAGI MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu maqola o'qiladi, shuning
  uchun mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish
  mumkin - matndan tekshiring.

  ⚠ 1-band kitobda ALLAQAChON
  belgilangan (namuna): 6:41.


⚠ 'CST' NIMA:

  = Central Standard Time
  = Markaziy standart vaqt (AQShning
    markaziy mintaqasi - Chikago).

  ⚠ Matnda: 'that's the same time that
  people in Chicago use'.

  ⚠ Kosmosda 'ertalab' va 'kechqurun'
  yo'q - shuning uchun ekipaj YERDAGI
  bir vaqt mintaqasiga qarab yashaydi.


⚠ SOATNI O'QISh:

  6:41 pm = 'six forty-one pm'
  ⚠ Yoki: 'nineteen minutes to seven'.

  ⚠ 'pm' = tushdan keyin (post meridiem)
  ⚠ 'am' = tushgacha (ante meridiem)


⚠ 'TWO SIX-HOUR' - DEFISGA DIQQAT:

  'two six-hour space walks'
  = ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr

  ⚠ 'six-hour' - defis bilan va HOUR
  BIRLIKDA ('six-hours' XATO), chunki
  u SIFAT vazifasida.

  ⚠ 'six two-hour' bo'lsa: oltita ikki
  soatlik sayr - butunlay boshqa ma'no!

tasks.prompt: 1  Mission Control wakes the crew up with music at exactly ___ pm CST.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda ALLAQAChON belgilangan - namuna.

⚠ Matnda: 'Mission Control wakes the crew up
with music at exactly 6:41pm CST'.

⚠ Matnda: "Washing isn't EASY in space."

⚠ DIQQAT: gapda INKOR bor. "isn't difficult"
teskari ma'no berardi.

tasks.prompt: 3  Each day there are also ___ space walks.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'Each day there are also TWO SIX-HOUR
space walks.'

⚠ IKKITA olti soatlik - oltita ikki soatlik emas!

tasks.prompt: 4  Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the ___ and the stars.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'we sit by the window and admire the
EARTH and the stars'.

⚠ 'the Earth' - sayyora nomi sifatida KATTA harf
va 'the' bilan.

exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Bu yana COLLOCATION mashqi.


⚠ 'A COUPLE OF HOURS':

  = bir-ikki soat.
  ⚠ 'a couple' aslida 'ikki' degani,
  lekin 'a couple of' aniq son emas -
  'bir nechta' ma'nosida.

  ⚠ 'of' ni TUShIRIB QOLDIRMANG:
  'a couple hours' - AQSh so'zlashuv
  nutqida uchraydi, lekin yozuvda XATO.


⚠ 'TO HELP EACH OTHER':

  = bir-biriga yordam bermoq.
  ⚠ 'each other' - IKKI kishi uchun.
  ⚠ 'one another' - ko'p kishi uchun
  (lekin farq deyarli yo'qolgan).


⚠ 'A ROCK SONG':

  ⚠ 'rock' bu yerda MUSIQA turi.
  Boshqa ma'nolari: tosh, qoya;
  tebranmoq.


⚠ 'PERSONAL' va 'PERSONNEL':

  personal (PER-sonal) = shaxsiy
  personnel (person-NEL) = xodimlar

  ⚠ Imlosi va urg'usi boshqa - juda
  ko'p adashtiriladi.


⚠ 'A WET SPONGE':

  ⚠ 'wet' = ho'l; aksi 'dry' = quruq.
  ⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi;
  'g' YuMShOQ (j kabi).

exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.

  ⚠ Har juftlikdagi ikki so'z o'zbekchaga
  BIR XIL tarjima qilinadi - shuning
  uchun ular ataylab qarshi qo'yilgan.


⚠ 'A PIECE' va 'A PART':

  a piece of music = musiqa ASARI
     (butun bir kuy)
  a part of sth = biror narsaning
     QISMI

  ⚠ 'music' sanalmaydigan, shuning
  uchun 'a PIECE of music'.


⚠ 'WORK' va 'A TASK':

  work = umuman ish (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  a task = aniq bitta vazifa
     (SANALADIGAN)

  ⚠ 'a difficult work' - XATO,
  chunki 'work' sanalmaydigan.
  To'g'risi: 'difficult work' yoki
  'a difficult task'.


⚠ 'A PROJECT' va 'A WORK':

  a project = reja asosidagi katta ish
  ⚠ 'works' (ko'plikda) = asarlar
  (adabiy, musiqiy) yoki zavod.


⚠ 'ADMIRE' va 'LOOK':

  to admire = zavq bilan qaramoq
  to look AT = shunchaki qaramoq

  ⚠ 4-bandda 'looking' variantida
  predlog 'AT' yo'q - shuning uchun
  ham grammatik jihatdan XATO
  bo'lardi.


⚠ 'TAKE UP' va 'TAKE OVER':

  take up = boshlamoq (mashg'ulot),
     joy egallamoq
  take over = navbatni/ishni qabul
     qilmoq

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the shuttle's computers
  TAKE OVER for the night'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in: crew, audience, fans, viewers.
exercises.instructionUz: Qo'ying: crew, audience, fans, viewers.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAMLAR GURUHINING NOMLARI.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada hammasi 'tomoshabinlar'
  yoki 'guruh' bo'lishi mumkin, lekin
  inglizchada HAR BIRI O'Z joyida
  ishlatiladi.


FARQLARI:

  a crew = kema/samolyot/kosmik kema
     XODIMLARI (ekipaj)

  an audience = teatr, konsert,
     ma'ruzadagi TINGLOVChILAR
     (bir joyda o'tirgan)

  fans = MUXLISLAR (sportchi, xonanda,
     jamoaning)

  viewers = TELEKO'RUVChILAR
     (uyda televizor ko'radiganlar)

  ⚠ 'a viewer' - 'to view' (ko'rmoq)
  fe'lidan.
  ⚠ 'a fan' - 'fanatic' so'zining qisqa
  shakli.


⚠ QAYSI FE'L QAYSI GURUH BILAN:

  crew    - welcomes passengers
  fans    - shout, cheer
  audience - claps, applauds
  viewers - watch

  ⚠ 2-bandda 'shouting' (baqirish) -
  bu STADIONDA bo'ladi, demak 'fans'.
  ⚠ 3-bandda 'clapped' (qarsak) va
  'the play' (spektakl) - demak
  'audience'.


⚠ JAMOA OTLARI - FE'L BIRLIKDAMI
YOKI KO'PLIKDA:

  Britaniyada IKKALASI ham mumkin:
     'The crew IS ready.' (bir butun)
     'The crew ARE ready.' (alohida
        odamlar)

  ⚠ Matnda: 'the crew WASH themselves'
  va 'The crew TAKE a short break' -
  KO'PLIKDA.

  ⚠ 'fans' va 'viewers' esa oddiy
  ko'plik otlar - har doim ko'plikda.

exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLI IBORALAR - HAMMASI
MAQOLADA BOR.

  ⚠ Predlogni MANTIQ bilan topib
  bo'lmaydi - ular ibora bilan BIRGA
  yodlanadi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  IN orbit = orbitada
     ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.

  ON a mission = topshiriqda
     ⚠ 'on a trip', 'on a journey' kabi.

  wake sb UP = uyg'otmoq
     ⚠ 'up' - predlog emas, ZARRAChA.
     To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
     mumkin: 'wake me up'.

  work ON projects = loyiha ustida
     ishlamoq

  go back TO work = ishga qaytmoq
     ⚠ 'work' artiklsiz.

  sit BY the window = deraza yonida
     o'tirmoq
     ⚠ 'by' = yonida, yaqinida.
     ⚠ 'at the window' ham mumkin.

  according TO NASA = NASA ma'lumotiga
     ko'ra
     ⚠ 'according to ME' - XATO!
     O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'
     deyiladi.

  take over FOR the night = tun uchun
     navbatni olmoq


⚠ 'WAKE UP' - IKKI XIL:

  o'timsiz: 'I wake up at seven.'
     (o'zim uyg'onaman)
  o'timli: 'She wakes me up.'
     (meni uyg'otadi)

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN orbit' - ARTIKLSIZ turg'un ibora.
⚠ Matnda: 'a typical day on a mission in orbit'.

⚠ 'ON a mission' - 'on a trip', 'on a journey'
kabi.

⚠ 'up' - ZARRAChA, predlog emas.
⚠ To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'wakes the crew up'.

⚠ 'to work ON sth' = biror ish ustida ishlamoq.
⚠ 'to work FOR a company' = kompaniyada
ishlamoq - boshqa predlog!

⚠ 'go back TO' - harakat yo'nalishi.
⚠ 'work' bu yerda ARTIKLSIZ.

⚠ 'by' = yonida, yaqinida.
⚠ 'at the window' ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Matnda: 'we sit BY the window'.

⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to'.

⚠ DIQQAT: 'according to me' - XATO!
O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'.

⚠ 'for' - qancha vaqtga.

⚠ Matnda: "the shuttle's computers take over
FOR the 'night'."

exercises.explanationUz:
AM / PM - 12 SOATLIK TIZIM.

  am = ante meridiem (lotincha:
    tushdan OLDIN) = 00:00-11:59
  pm = post meridiem (lotincha:
    tushdan KEYIN) = 12:00-23:59

  ⚠ 'noon' = tush (12:00 kunduzi)
  ⚠ 'midnight' = yarim tun (12:00
  tunda)


⚠ SO'Z BILAN AYTGANDA am/pm
  O'RNIGA:

  in the morning   = 5-12 (am)
  in the afternoon = 12-17 (pm)
  in the evening   = 17-21 (pm)
  at night         = 21-5


⚠ VAQT AYTISh QOIDASI:

  8:00 = eight o'clock
  5:30 = half PAST five
  10:15 = a quarter PAST ten
  9:45 = a quarter TO ten
  3:20 = twenty PAST three

  ⚠ 'past' = ... dan o'tdi (:01-:30)
  ⚠ 'to' = ... ga qoldi (:31-:59)
  ⚠ 'o'clock' - FAQAT to'liq soatda.


⚠ 4 AM = 'four o'clock in the
  morning' - ha, tong 4 ham
  'morning'!

⚠ NAMUNA. 6 pm = kechqurun → 'in the evening'.
⚠ To'liq soat → 'o'clock'. 4 am - tong → 'in the morning'.

⚠ :30 = 'half PAST' + soat. am → 'in the morning'.
⚠ 'o'clock' YO'Q - to'liq soat emas.

⚠ :15 = 'a quarter PAST'. 10 pm = tun → 'at night'.
⚠ 'in the evening' ham qabul qilinadi.

⚠ :45 = 'a quarter TO' + KEYINGI soat (ten).
⚠ 'to nine' - XATO!
⚠ :20 = 'twenty PAST'. 3 pm → 'in the afternoon'.

tasks.uz: Har 'ertalab' Boshqaruv markazi ekipajni aynan CST bo'yicha 18:41 da musiqa bilan uyg'otadi (Markaziy standart vaqt - Chikago aholisi ishlatadigan vaqt).
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to wake sb UP' - 'up' zarrachasi bilan.
To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'wakes the crew up'.
⚠ 'exactly' = aynan, roppa-rosa.

tasks.en: The pieces of music are always different. For example, they might wake up to a traditional Japanese song one day, and a new American rock song the next!
tasks.uz: Musiqa asarlari har doim boshqacha. Masalan, bir kuni an'anaviy yapon qo'shig'i bilan, ertasiga yangi amerika rok qo'shig'i bilan uyg'onishlari mumkin!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a piece of music' = musiqa asari.
'music' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning uchun
'a piece of' kerak.
⚠ 'might' = ehtimol (5-mashqning javobi).

tasks.en: After that, they have a couple of hours to wash, have breakfast and get the 'morning' messages from Mission Control.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin ularda yuvinish, nonushta qilish va Boshqaruv markazidan 'ertalabki' xabarlarni olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a couple of' = bir-ikki (aniq ikki emas).
⚠ 'to have time TO DO sth' - infinitiv.

tasks.en: Washing isn't easy in space, and it's impossible to have a shower, so the crew wash themselves with a wet sponge.
tasks.uz: Kosmosda yuvinish oson emas va dush qabul qilish imkonsiz, shuning uchun ekipaj o'zini ho'l gubka bilan yuvadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Kosmosda og'irlik yo'q - suv oqmaydi, balki
sharcha bo'lib uchadi.
⚠ 'themselves' - O'ZLIK olmoshi.
⚠ 'a sponge' - 'spanj' deb o'qiladi.

tasks.en: Shaving is also a difficult task up there, so the men have to use special 'space' razors.
tasks.uz: U yerda soqol olish ham qiyin vazifa, shuning uchun erkaklar maxsus 'kosmik' ustaralardan foydalanishga majbur.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'shaving' - -ING shakli EGA vazifasida.
⚠ 'a task' = vazifa (7-mashqda ham bor).
⚠ 'have to' = majbur bo'lmoq (10-unit mavzusi).

tasks.en: At around 8:45 pm CST, the crew starts work. Most of the time they work on projects involving satellites and the shuttle itself.
tasks.uz: CST bo'yicha taxminan 20:45 da ekipaj ishni boshlaydi. Ko'p vaqt ular sun'iy yo'ldoshlar va kemaning o'ziga oid loyihalar ustida ishlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to work ON a project' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 'involving' = o'z ichiga olgan.
⚠ 'the shuttle ITSELF' = kemaning O'ZI
(ta'kidlash uchun).

tasks.en: They also take photos of their activities and the view from the shuttle to send home.
tasks.uz: Ular yana mashg'ulotlarining va kemadan ko'rinadigan manzaraning suratini olib, uyga yuboradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to TAKE photos' - 'to make' EMAS.
⚠ 'a view OF sth' - predlog 'of'.

tasks.en: Each day there are also two six-hour space walks.
tasks.uz: Har kuni yana ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan, HOUR BIRLIKDA
(sifat vazifasida).
⚠ 'each day' = har kuni ('every day' bilan
bir xil).

tasks.en: "We have between eight and ten minutes to do each task," says Leroy, "so we have to work very closely and help each other."
tasks.uz: "Har vazifani bajarish uchun sakkiz-o'n daqiqamiz bor," - deydi Leroy, "shuning uchun juda zich ishlashimiz va bir-birimizga yordam berishimiz kerak."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'between ... and ...' = ... dan ... gacha.
⚠ 'closely' - RAVISh ('close' + -ly).
⚠ 'each other' = bir-biri (12-betdagi
3b mashqida ham bor).

tasks.en: The crew take a short break for lunch during the 'afternoon'.
tasks.uz: Ekipaj 'tushdan keyin' tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to TAKE a break' - 'to do' EMAS.
⚠ 'the crew TAKE' - Britaniyada jamoa oti bilan
fe'l KO'PLIKDA bo'lishi mumkin.

tasks.en: They need a lot of energy, so they eat a lot of food. According to NASA, the crew's special meals are "tasty and very good for them".
tasks.uz: Ularga ko'p quvvat kerak, shuning uchun ko'p ovqat yeydi. NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, ekipajning maxsus taomlari "mazali va ular uchun juda foydali".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'good FOR sb' = foydali.
⚠ 'energy' va 'food' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar,
shuning uchun 'a lot of'.

tasks.en: After lunch, they go back to work until around 8:45 am CST.
tasks.uz: Tushlikdan keyin ular CST bo'yicha taxminan 08:45 gacha ishga qaytadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'go back TO work' - predlog 'to' (9-mashqda).
⚠ 'work' bu yerda artiklsiz.

tasks.en: "Fortunately, it's not all work and no play aboard the space shuttle," says Leroy.
tasks.uz: "Yaxshiyamki, kosmik kemada faqat ish emas," - deydi Leroy.
tasks.note:
⚠ To'liq maqol: 'All work and no play makes
Jack a dull boy.' = Faqat ishlab dam olmagan
odam zerikarli bo'lib qoladi.

⚠ 'fortunately' = yaxshiyamki ('fortune' -
omad).

tasks.en: "In the 'evening' we all have a couple of hours to have dinner and relax. Most of us read and send our personal e-mail in this free time, but we also like to read books or listen to music."
tasks.uz: "'Kechqurun' hammamizda kechki ovqat qilish va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat bo'ladi. Ko'pchiligimiz shu bo'sh vaqtda shaxsiy elektron xatlarimizni o'qiymiz va yuboramiz, lekin kitob o'qish yoki musiqa tinglashni ham yoqtiramiz."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'most of us' - 'of' bilan (olmoshdan oldin).
⚠ 'personal' = shaxsiy (6-mashqda ham bor).

tasks.en: "Sometimes we sit by the window and admire the Earth and the stars."
tasks.uz: "Ba'zan deraza yonida o'tirib Yer va yulduzlarga zavq bilan qaraymiz."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to sit BY the window' - predlog 'by'
(= yonida).
⚠ 'to admire' = zavqlanib qaramoq
(7-mashqda ham bor).

tasks.en: After that, at exactly 10:41 am CST, it's time for the crew to go to bed, while Mission Control and the shuttle's computers take over for the 'night'.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin, CST bo'yicha aynan 10:41 da ekipajning uxlash vaqti keladi, Boshqaruv markazi va kemaning kompyuterlari esa 'tun' uchun navbatni oladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ "it's time for sb TO DO sth" - turg'un qolip.
⚠ 'to go TO bed' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'to take over' = navbatni olmoq, ish boshini
qabul qilmoq (7 va 9-mashqlarda ham bor).

exercises.instructionEn: From Rags to Riches
exercises.instructionUz: Yalang'ochlikdan boylikka
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda TO'G'RI TARTIBDA berilgan.


⚠ SARLAVHA: 'FROM RAGS TO RICHES'

  So'zma-so'z: 'lattadan boylikka'.
  = kambag'allikdan boylikka chiqish.

  ⚠ 'rags' = eski, yirtiq kiyim.
  ⚠ 'riches' = boylik (HAR DOIM
  KO'PLIKDA).

  ⚠ Bu - juda mashhur ingliz iborasi;
  odatda o'zi mehnat qilib boyib ketgan
  odam haqida aytiladi.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'yo'qdan bor bo'ldi'.


⚠ MAQOLANING TO'G'RI TARTIBI
(23-mashqning javobi):

  1 - C  (kirish: Liza kim)
  2 - A  (o'tmish: qanday yashagan)
  3 - D  (bugun: qanday yashaydi)
  4 - B  (xulosa: uning fikri)

  ⚠ Bu - odatiy MAQOLA tuzilishi:
     kirish → o'tmish → hozir → xulosa


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI:

  C dan boshlanadi, chunki u YaGONA
  xatboshi bo'lib, unda Lizaning TO'LIQ
  ISMI bor: 'Liza Smythe is a successful
  British singer.'
  ⚠ Keyingi xatboshilarda faqat 'Liza'
  yoki 'she' deyilgan - demak ular
  keyin keladi.

  A da 'HOWEVER' bor - qarama-qarshilik
  bog'lovchisi. Demak undan oldin
  ijobiy narsa aytilgan bo'lishi kerak
  (C dagi muvaffaqiyat).

  D 'TODAY' bilan boshlanadi - o'tmishdan
  keyin keladi.

  B - xulosa: 'Liza's lifestyle HAS
  CHANGED a lot SINCE those days' va
  oxirida 'she says'.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  bright        = yorqin; iqtidorli
  a terraced house = qatorli uy
  cramped       = tor, siqiq
  to make ends meet = kunini ko'rmoq
  a choir       = xor
  to hire       = yollamoq
  to persuade   = ko'ndirmoq
  to lead the life = hayot kechirmoq
  privacy       = shaxsiy hayot
  a promising career = istiqbolli
                  martaba
  to perform concerts = konsert bermoq
  elegant       = nafis, ozoda
  constantly on a diet = doim parhezda
  in shape      = sport shaklida

tasks.en: From Rags to Riches
tasks.uz: Yalang'ochlikdan boylikka

tasks.en: [C] Liza Smythe is a successful British singer. Her smiling face appears on the covers of international magazines, and every year she travels to many different parts of the world to perform concerts for millions of fans.
tasks.uz: [C] Liza Smit - muvaffaqiyatli britaniyalik qo'shiqchi. Uning kulib turgan yuzi xalqaro jurnallar muqovasida chiqadi va har yili u millionlab muxlislarga konsert berish uchun dunyoning turli burchaklariga sayohat qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu - BIRINChI xatboshi (kirish).

⚠ Yagona xatboshi bo'lib, unda Lizaning
TO'LIQ ISMI bor - shuning uchun u birinchi.

⚠ 'to perform concerts' - 'to make' EMAS.
⚠ 'a cover' = muqova.

tasks.en: [A] However, life used to be very different for this bright young star from Liverpool. "Eight years ago," says Liza, "I lived in a small terraced house with my parents and three brothers. It was very cramped!"
tasks.uz: [A] Ammo bu iqtidorli yosh Liverpul yulduzi uchun hayot ilgari juda boshqacha edi. "Sakkiz yil oldin," - deydi Liza, "ota-onam va uch akam bilan kichkina qatorli uyda yashardim. U juda tor edi!"
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu - IKKINChI xatboshi.

⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi:
demak oldin IJOBIY narsa aytilgan.

⚠ 'a terraced house' = yon devorlari qo'shni
uy bilan umumiy bo'lgan qatorli uy - Britaniyada
juda keng tarqalgan.
⚠ 'cramped' = tor, siqiq.

⚠ 22-mashqning 1-gapida 'a BIG terraced house'
deyilgan - shuning uchun javob F.

tasks.en: [A] "We didn't have a lot of money, so I used to work as a cleaner at the local hospital to make ends meet. I used to buy my clothes from second-hand shops."
tasks.uz: [A] "Pulimiz ko'p emas edi, shuning uchun kunimni ko'rish uchun mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardim. Kiyimlarimni ikkinchi qo'l do'konlaridan sotib olardim."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'used to work' - o'tmishdagi ODAT.
⚠ 'to work AS a cleaner' - kasb oldidan 'as'.
⚠ 'to make ends meet' - IBORA: zo'rg'a kunini
ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'second-hand' = ikkinchi qo'l (ishlatilgan).

tasks.en: [A] "I was quite plump back then, because I liked eating chips and chocolate. In my free time I used to sing in the college choir or go for walks on the beach."
tasks.uz: [A] "O'sha paytlar ancha to'ladan kelgan edim, chunki kartoshka fri va shokolad yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardim. Bo'sh vaqtimda kollej xorida kuylardim yoki plyajda sayr qilardim."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'plump' = to'ladan kelgan (8-betdagi jadvalda
ham bor edi).
⚠ 'back then' = o'sha paytlar.
⚠ 'a choir' - imlosi g'alati, /ˈkwaɪə/ deb
o'qiladi.
⚠ 'to go for a walk' = sayr qilmoq.

tasks.en: [A] "I didn't use to go to clubs because they were very expensive. I used to listen to the radio a lot, though. I learnt all the words to every pop song and people hired me to sing at parties."
tasks.uz: [A] "Klublarga bormasdim, chunki ular juda qimmat edi. Lekin radioni ko'p tinglardim. Har bir pop qo'shiqning hamma so'zini yodlab olgandim va odamlar meni bazmlarda kuylashga yollardi."
tasks.note:
⚠ "didn't USE to" - INKORDA 'use', 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = 'lekin'.
⚠ 'to hire' = yollamoq.
⚠ 'learnt' - Britaniya shakli ('learned' - AQSh).

tasks.en: [A] "My friends liked my voice a lot, so they persuaded me to send a cassette to a record company. That's how it all started for me. Three weeks later, I received a phone call from the company and my life changed completely."
tasks.uz: [A] "Do'stlarimga ovozim juda yoqardi, shuning uchun ular meni yozuv kompaniyasiga kasseta yuborishga ko'ndirishdi. Hammasi shundan boshlandi. Uch hafta o'tib kompaniyadan qo'ng'iroq oldim va hayotim butunlay o'zgardi."
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to persuade sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'a record company' = yozuv kompaniyasi.
⚠ "That's how it all started" - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'completely' = butunlay.

tasks.en: [D] Today, Liza lives in a large house with a big garden just outside London with her husband and young daughter. She is much slimmer now, and looks very elegant in her chic designer clothes.
tasks.uz: [D] Bugun Liza turmush o'rtog'i va yosh qizi bilan London chekkasidagi katta bog'li katta uyda yashaydi. U hozir ancha nozikroq va nafis dizayner kiyimlarida juda chiroyli ko'rinadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu - UChINChI xatboshi ('Today' bilan
boshlanadi).

⚠ 22-mashqning 4-gapida 'a large BLOCK OF FLATS'
deyilgan - shuning uchun javob F.

⚠ 'much slimmer' - 'much' qiyosiy darajani
kuchaytiradi.
⚠ 'chic' - fransuzcha, /ʃiːk/ deb o'qiladi.

tasks.en: [D] She is constantly on a diet and goes to the gym every day to keep her body in shape. In her free time she enjoys going to the theatre or to parties.
tasks.uz: [D] U doim parhezda va tanasini sport shaklida saqlash uchun har kuni sport zaliga boradi. Bo'sh vaqtida teatrga yoki bazmlarga borishni yoqtiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'on a diet' = parhezda.
⚠ 'in shape' = sport shaklida.
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

⚠ 22-mashqning 6-gapida 'the CINEMA' deyilgan -
shuning uchun javob F (matnda 'theatre').

tasks.en: [B] Liza's lifestyle has changed a lot since those days in Liverpool. "I think I'm very lucky to lead the life I do today. It's not easy, though, because I don't have the privacy that I used to have."
tasks.uz: [B] Lizaning turmush tarzi Liverpuldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi. "Menimcha, bugungi hayotni kechirayotganim uchun juda omadliman. Lekin oson emas, chunki ilgarigi shaxsiy hayotim endi yo'q."
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu - OXIRGI xatboshi (xulosa).

⚠ 'has changed ... since' - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'to lead a life' = hayot kechirmoq.
⚠ 'privacy' = shaxsiy hayot, tinchlik.

tasks.en: [B] "Still, I have a lovely family and a very promising career. What else could I ask for?" she says.
tasks.uz: [B] "Baribir, menda ajoyib oila va juda istiqbolli martaba bor. Yana nima kerak?" - deydi u.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'still' bu yerda = baribir, shunga qaramay.
⚠ 'promising' = istiqbolli ('to promise' -
va'da bermoq).
⚠ 'What else could I ask for?' - ritorik savol:
'bundan ortiq nima kerak?'

exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va xatboshilarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI:

  KIRISh → O'TMISh → HOZIR → XULOSA


QANDAY TOPILADI - UCh BELGI:

  1) TO'LIQ ISM birinchi xatboshida
     bo'ladi:
     C: 'LIZA SMYTHE is a successful
        British singer.'
     ⚠ Qolganlarida faqat 'Liza' yoki
     'she'.

  2) BOG'LOVChI SO'ZLAR:
     A: 'HOWEVER, life USED TO BE very
        different' - qarama-qarshilik +
        o'tmish
     D: 'TODAY, Liza lives ...' - hozir
     B: 'has changed a lot SINCE those

  3) ZAMONLAR:
     C - present simple (doimiy holat)
     A - past simple / used to (o'tmish)
     D - present simple (hozirgi holat)
     B - present perfect (o'zgarish
        natijasi)


⚠ NIMA UChUN 'B' OXIRIDA:

  B da UMUMLAShTIRUVChI fikr bor:
  'What else could I ask for?' -
  bu ritorik savol, xulosaga xos.

  ⚠ Yana B da 'SINCE those days in
  Liverpool' deyilgan - demak
  Liverpul haqida allaqachon aytilgan
  (A xatboshida).

exercises.explanationUz:
QALAMKASh DO'STGA XAT - SALLY
  SHELBY (13 yosh, Toronto).
  (coursebook 15-bet Project - Steve
  xati bilan bir xil qolip)

TUZILISh (4 xatboshi):
  1 Ism, shahar, yosh, TAShQI
    QIYOFA
  2 OILA (a'zolari, kasblari,
    xarakteri)
  3 YOQTIRGAN NARSALAR (bo'sh
    vaqt, sevimli ...)
  4 XULOSA (that's all about me,
    write back soon)


⚠ 'THERE ARE FOUR OF US':

  = Biz to'rt kishimiz. 'four of
  us' - 'we are four' EMAS!


⚠ 'AGED FOURTEEN':

  = o'n to'rt yoshli. 'aged' + son.


⚠ 'A BIT BOSSY':

  'bossy' = buyruqboz (boshqalarga
  buyruq berishni yoqtiradigan).
  'a bit' = biroz - yumshatadi.
  'can be ... sometimes' = ba'zan
  ... bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ 'THE LOCAL LIBRARY':

  'local' = mahalliy; 'a library' =
  kutubxona (do'kon EMAS -
  'bookshop').


⚠ SHAQUILLE O'NEAL:

  = mashhur amerikalik basketbolchi
  (NBA, 2,16 m).
  MARIAH CAREY = amerikalik
  qo'shiqchi.


⚠ 'THAT'S ALL ABOUT ME':

  = Men haqimda shu. Xat xulosasi.


⚠ 'WRITE BACK SOON':

⚠ 'BY BUS' - TRANSPORT USULI:

3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI
(10-mashqning butun mavzusi):

  1) Ko'pchilik fe'lga oddiy -S:
     play → plays, read → reads,
     make → makes, leave → leaves

  2) -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X bilan
     tugasa → -ES:
     go → goes, do → does,
     watch → watches, finish → finishes,
     brush → brushes, fix → fixes

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IES:
     study → studies, fly → flies

  4) UNLI + Y → faqat -S:
     play → plays, buy → buys

  5) ISTISNO: have → HAS

  /s/  - jarangsiz tovushdan keyin:
     makes, sleeps, works
  /z/  - jarangli tovushdan keyin:
     plays, reads, goes
  /iz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan keyin:
     watches, finishes, brushes

  ⚠ Bu qoida ko'plik -S ga ham,
  o'tgan zamon -ED ga ham o'xshash.

exercises.instructionEn: We use used to or the past simple to describe past habits and states which don't happen/exist any more. We use the past simple for an action which happened at a specific time in the past.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi sodir bo'lmaydigan yoki mavjud bo'lmagan o'tmishdagi odat va holatlarni tasvirlash uchun 'used to' yoki past simple ishlatiladi. O'tmishda aniq vaqtda sodir bo'lgan ish uchun past simple ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  1) 'We use USED TO or the PAST SIMPLE
     to describe past habits and states
     which don't happen/exist any more.'

     I worked / used to work as a cleaner.
        (past habit)
     I didn't have / didn't use to have
     long hair.  (state)

  2) 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action
     which happened at a specific time
     in the past.'

     We WENT to the beach last Saturday.
     NOT: We used to go to the beach
          last Saturday.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  ANIQ VAQT ko'rsatilgan bo'lsa
  ('last Saturday', 'in 1999',
  'yesterday') - FAQAT past simple.

  ⚠ 'used to' TAKRORLANGAN odat yoki
  UZOQ DAVOM ETGAN holat uchun.


'USED TO' NING ShAKLLARI:

  Tasdiq:  I used to work.
  Inkor:   I didn't USE to work.
           (⚠ 'used' emas, 'USE'!)
  So'roq:  Did you USE to work?
           (⚠ yana 'USE')

  ⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan
  XATO. 'did' allaqachon o'tgan
  zamonni ko'rsatgan.


⚠ 'USED TO' va 'BE USED TO' -
BUTUNLAY BOShQA:

  'I used to smoke.'
     = ilgari chekardim (endi yo'q)

  'I am used to smoking.'
     = chekishga o'rganib qolganman

  ⚠ Ikkinchisida 'be' bor va keyin
  -ING keladi!


PAST SIMPLE QANDAY YaSALADI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (regular): + -ED
     start → started
     enjoy → enjoyed
     live  → lived   ('e' bor, faqat -D)
     travel → travelled (Britaniyada
        'l' IKKILANADI)
     study → studied (undosh + y → -ied)

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (irregular):
     be    → was/were
     go    → went
     sing  → sang
     have  → had
     learn → learnt (yoki learned)

  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati kitob
  oxirida (128-bet).


⚠ -ED NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /t/  - jarangsizdan keyin: worked,
         watched, finished
  /d/  - jaranglidan keyin: lived,
         enjoyed, travelled
  /id/ - 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin:
         started, needed, wanted

  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning talaffuz mavzusi.

exercises.instructionUz: Present simple shakllarini past simple shakllari bilan moslang. Past simple qanday yasaladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH - IKKI QOIDA.

  ⚠ Kitob ataylab ikki ramkaga
  bo'lgan:

  CHAP RAMKA (och pushti) - ichida
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar ham bor:
     appear → appeared (to'g'ri)
     travel → travelled (to'g'ri)
     be     → was      (NOTO'G'RI)
     live   → lived    (to'g'ri)
     sing   → sang     (NOTO'G'RI)
     go     → went     (NOTO'G'RI)

  O'NG RAMKA (och yashil):
     learn   → learnt   (NOTO'G'RI/to'g'ri)
     receive → received (to'g'ri)
     start   → started  (to'g'ri)
     change  → changed  (to'g'ri)
     have    → had      (NOTO'G'RI)
     enjoy   → enjoyed  (to'g'ri)


⚠ -ED QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:

  1) Oddiy: start → startED,
     appear → appearED, enjoy → enjoyED

  2) 'E' bilan tugasa - faqat -D:
     live → liveD, receive → receiveD,
     change → changeD

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IED:
     study → studied, carry → carried

  4) UNLI + Y → oddiy -ED:
     enjoy → enjoyed, play → played

  5) Qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
     UNDOSh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped, plan → planned
     ⚠ Britaniyada 'travel' → 'travelLED'
     (AQShda 'traveled').


⚠ 'LEARNT' va 'LEARNED':

  Britaniyada 'learnt', AQShda
  'learned'. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: burnt/burned,
  dreamt/dreamed, spelt/spelled.


⚠ 'BE' - ENG NOTO'G'RI FE'L:

  I / he / she / it → WAS
  you / we / they   → WERE

  ⚠ Bu YAGONA fe'l bo'lib, o'tgan
  zamonda IKKI shaklga ega.

'THEN' VA 'NOW' - O'ZGARISh.

   hair.'

     PRESENT.

  short orange hair - kalta to'q sariq soch
  glasses - ko'zoynak
  brightly coloured T-shirts - yorqin
     rangli futbolkalar
  ripped jeans - yirtiq jinsi

  eyes: contact lenses
  * ⚠ clothes: smart ... (qanaqa - audiodan)
  habits: not smoke any more


⚠ 'USED TO BE LIKE':

  'what Pauline used to BE LIKE'
  = Polina qanday ODAM/QANDAY
    KO'RINIShDA bo'lgan.

  ⚠ 'be like' - 6-betdagi 2-mashqda
  o'rganilgan edi.


⚠ 'GLASSES' va 'CONTACT LENSES':

  ⚠ 'jeans' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA

  kiyingan.
  ⚠ AQShda 'smart' = AQLLI.
  ⚠ Britaniyada aqlli - 'clever'.

  'She doesn't smoke ANY MORE.'
  = U endi chekmaydi.

  ⚠ 'any more' (ikki so'z) - Britaniya;
  'anymore' (bir so'z) - AQSh.


⚠ GAP TUZISh QOLIPI:

  'She used to ... , but now she ... '
  yoki
  'She didn't use to ... , but now
   she ... '

exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlarini tartib bilan yozing, so'ng gapda ular odatda qayerga qo'yilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - 0% dan
100% gacha.

  1  never        0%
  2  rarely       ~10%
  3  occasionally ~25%
  4  sometimes    ~40%
  5  often        ~60%
  6  usually      ~85%
  7  always       100%

  ⚠ Kitobda 1 (never) va 7 (always)
  BERILGAN - qolgan beshtasini
  ro'yxatdan joylashtirasiz.


⚠ GAPDA QAYERGA QO'YILADI - UCh QOIDA:

  1) ODDIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     'I ALWAYS get up early.'
     'He OFTEN plays football.'

  2) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'
     'They are USUALLY at home.'
     ⚠ 'She always is late' - XATO!

  3) YORDAMChI FE'L BILAN - o'rtada:
     'I have NEVER been to London.'
     'He can USUALLY come.'

  ⚠ Qisqa qoida: ravish ASOSIY fe'ldan
  oldin, lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ ISTISNO - GAP BOShIDA VA OXIRIDA:

  'sometimes', 'usually', 'often',
  'occasionally' gap boshida ham
  turishi mumkin:
     'Sometimes I go to the cinema.'

  ⚠ Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap
  boshida TURMAYDI (buyruq gapdan
  tashqari: 'Never do that!').


⚠ 'RARELY', 'SELDOM', 'HARDLY EVER':

  Uchalasi ham 'kamdan-kam' degani.
  ⚠ Ular INKOR ma'noli, shuning uchun
  gapda yana 'not' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'I rarely don't go' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW OFTEN ...?' - SAVOL:

  'How often do you play tennis?'
     - 'Twice a week.'
     - 'I usually play at weekends.'

exercises.explanationUz:
O'QILMAYDIGAN HARFLAR (silent letters).

  ⚠ Ingliz tilida YoZILADIGAN, lekin
  AYTILMAYDIGAN harflar juda ko'p.
  Bu - imlo va talaffuz orasidagi
  eng katta farq.


BETDAGI SAKKIZ SO'Z:

  know   - 'K' o'qilmaydi  /nəʊ/
  listen - 'T' o'qilmaydi  /ˈlɪsn/
  write  - 'W' o'qilmaydi  /raɪt/
  often  - 'T' o'qilmaydi  /ˈɒfn/
  talk   - 'L' o'qilmaydi  /tɔːk/
  walk   - 'L' o'qilmaydi  /wɔːk/
  hour   - 'H' o'qilmaydi  /ˈaʊə/
  comb   - 'B' o'qilmaydi  /kəʊm/

  ⚠ Kitobda 'know' so'zidagi 'k'
  ALLAQAChON chizilgan - namuna.


UMUMIY QOIDALAR:

  'K' + N boshida → K jim:
     know, knee, knife, knock, knot

  'W' + R boshida → W jim:
     write, wrong, wrap, wrist

  'L' oldida A/O va keyin K/M/F →
  L jim:
     talk, walk, calm, half, could,
     should, would

  'B' oxirida M dan keyin → B jim:
     comb, thumb, lamb, climb, bomb

  'H' ba'zi so'zlarda jim:
     hour, honest, honour, heir
     ⚠ Bunday so'zlar oldidan 'AN'
     artikli keladi: 'AN hour',
     'AN honest man'.

  'T' -STEN/-FTEN da jim:
     listen, fasten, castle, often
     ⚠ 'often' da 't' ni aytish ham
     to'g'ri hisoblanadi - ikki xil
     talaffuz bor.


⚠ 11-BETDAGI 31-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  U yerda 'know' va 'no' bir xil
  o'qilishi ko'rsatilgan edi - aynan
  'k' jim bo'lgani uchun.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ /nəʊ/ - 'k' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ Qoida: 'KN' boshida → K jim (know, knee,
knife, knock).

⚠ /ˈlɪsn/ - 't' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: '-STEN' da T jim (listen, fasten,
castle).

⚠ /raɪt/ - 'w' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: 'WR' boshida → W jim (write, wrong,
wrap, wrist).

⚠ Shuning uchun 'write' va 'right' bir xil
o'qiladi.

⚠ /ˈɒfn/ - 't' odatda O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Lekin 't' ni aytish ham to'g'ri hisoblanadi -
ikki xil talaffuz mavjud.

⚠ /tɔːk/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: A/O + L + K/M/F → L jim (talk, walk,
calm, half).

⚠ /wɔːk/ - 'l' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ 'talk' bilan bir xil qoida.

⚠ /ˈaʊə/ - 'h' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Shuning uchun 'AN hour' ('a hour' XATO).
⚠ Yana: honest, honour, heir.

⚠ /kəʊm/ - 'b' O'QILMAYDI.

⚠ Qoida: '-MB' oxirida B jim (comb, thumb,
lamb, climb, bomb).

BILL NYUTON - BRITANIYaNING ENG

rejasidan ma'lum).

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did Bill use to live in a large
      house?
  SB: No, he didn't. He used to live in
      a flat.

  ⚠ Namunadan BITTA javob ma'lum bo'ladi:
  HOME / THEN = a FLAT.


JADVAL (bosh harflari kitobda berilgan):

  HOME
     THEN: a f___ in the middle of
           Bristol  → a FLAT
     * ⚠ NOW: a large h___ with a garden
       in the countryside (audiodan)

  APPEARANCE
     * ⚠ THEN: long hair, quite p___,
       blue j___ (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: slim, handsome, s___ hair,
       expensive s___ (audiodan)

  EATING HABITS
     * ⚠ THEN: hamburgers, c___ (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: f___, salads, orange juice
       (audiodan)

  FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES
     * ⚠ THEN: football, c___, rock
       concerts (audiodan)
     * ⚠ NOW: parties, nightclubs, t___
       (audiodan)


⚠ 'DID ... USE TO ...?' - SO'ROQ:

  'DID Bill USE to live ...?'
  ⚠ SO'ROQDA ham 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
  ⚠ 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni
  ko'rsatgan.


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  'No, he didn't.' - keyin to'liq gap:
  'He used to live in a flat.'


⚠ 'IN THE COUNTRYSIDE':

  = qishloq joyda, shahardan tashqarida.
  ⚠ 'the country' ham shu ma'noda
  ('mamlakat' bilan adashtirmang).


⚠ 'A FLAT' va 'AN APARTMENT':

  Britaniyada 'a flat', AQShda
  'an apartment'.
  ⚠ 16-betda 'a block of flats' bor edi.

tasks.en: the 'morning': 6:41 pm CST - wake up with music; a couple of hours to wash (wet sponge, special razors), have breakfast, get messages from Mission Control
tasks.uz: 'ertalab': CST 18:41 - musiqa bilan uyg'onish; yuvinish (ho'l gubka, maxsus ustara), nonushta, Boshqaruv markazidan xabarlar olish uchun bir-ikki soat
tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning 'Good Morning!' qismidan.

⚠ Gapirganda: 'The crew wakeS up at 6:41 pm.'
- PRESENT SIMPLE, 3-shaxs -S.

tasks.en: the 'afternoon': 8:45 pm CST - start work; projects with satellites, take photos, two six-hour space walks, work closely and help each other; a short break for lunch; back to work until 8:45 am
tasks.uz: 'tushdan keyin': CST 20:45 - ish boshlanadi; sun'iy yo'ldosh loyihalari, surat olish, ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr, zich ishlash va bir-biriga yordam; tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus; 08:45 gacha yana ish
tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning "Let's get busy!" qismidan.

⚠ 'to TAKE photos', 'to TAKE a break' -
ikkalasi ham 'take' bilan.

tasks.en: the 'evening': a couple of hours for dinner and relaxing; read and send personal e-mail, read books, listen to music, sit by the window and admire the Earth; 10:41 am CST - go to bed
tasks.uz: 'kechqurun': kechki ovqat va dam olish uchun bir-ikki soat; shaxsiy elektron xat o'qish va yuborish, kitob o'qish, musiqa tinglash, deraza yonida o'tirib Yerga zavq bilan qarash; CST 10:41 - uxlash
tasks.note:
⚠ Maqolaning 'Astronauts need to rest, too!'
qismidan.

⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

tasks.en: A typical day: First, the crew wake up at 6:41 pm CST. Then they wash and have breakfast. After that, they start work at 8:45 pm. Finally, they go to bed at 10:41 am.
tasks.uz: Odatiy kun: Avval ekipaj CST bo'yicha 18:41 da uyg'onadi. Keyin yuvinadi va nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin 20:45 da ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, 10:41 da uxlagani yotadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI: First, Then,
After that, Finally.

⚠ Ular gapni bog'laydi va nutqni tushunarli
qiladi - bu 4-unitning mavzusi ham.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and take notes under the headings THEN and NOW. Then, talk about Liza's home, work, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani qayta o'qing va THEN (o'sha payt) va NOW (hozir) sarlavhalari ostida qayd oling. So'ng Lizaning uyi, ishi, tashqi qiyofasi, ovqatlanish odati va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
'THEN' VA 'NOW' - QIYoSLASh.

  ⚠ 15-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil
  g'oya: o'tmish va hozirni solishtirish.


GAPIRISh QOLIPI:

  'Liza used to ... , but now she ... '

  yoki

  'She didn't use to ... , but now
   she ... '

  ⚠ 'used to' - o'tmish uchun
  ⚠ present simple - hozir uchun


BESh MAVZU:

  home (uy)
  work (ish)
  appearance (tashqi qiyofa)
  eating habits (ovqatlanish odati)
  free-time activities (bo'sh vaqt)

  ⚠ Bandlarda har mavzu bo'yicha
  THEN va NOW berilgan.


⚠ 'EATING HABITS':

  = ovqatlanish odatlari.
  ⚠ 'a habit' = odat.
  ⚠ 'to eat' + -ING sifat vazifasida.

tasks.en: Read the article again and take notes under the headings THEN and NOW. Then, talk about Liza's home, work, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.
tasks.uz: Maqolani qayta o'qing va THEN (o'sha payt) va NOW (hozir) sarlavhalari ostida qayd oling. So'ng Lizaning uyi, ishi, tashqi qiyofasi, ovqatlanish odati va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari haqida gapiring.

tasks.en: HOME - THEN: a small, cramped terraced house in Liverpool with her parents and three brothers. NOW: a large house with a big garden just outside London with her husband and daughter.
tasks.uz: UY - O'ShA PAYT: Liverpulda ota-onasi va uch akasi bilan kichkina, tor qatorli uy. HOZIR: London chekkasida turmush o'rtog'i va qizi bilan katta bog'li katta uy.
tasks.note:
⚠ Gap: 'Liza used to live in a small terraced
house, but now she lives in a large house.'

⚠ 'just outside London' = London chekkasida.

tasks.en: WORK - THEN: she used to work as a cleaner at the local hospital. NOW: she is a successful singer and performs concerts around the world.
tasks.uz: ISH - O'ShA PAYT: mahalliy kasalxonada farrosh bo'lib ishlardi. HOZIR: muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi va dunyo bo'ylab konsert beradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to work AS' - kasb oldidan 'as'.
⚠ 'to perform concerts' - 'to make' EMAS.

tasks.en: APPEARANCE - THEN: she was quite plump and bought her clothes from second-hand shops. NOW: she is much slimmer and looks elegant in chic designer clothes.
tasks.uz: TASHQI QIYOFA - O'ShA PAYT: ancha to'ladan kelgan edi va kiyimlarini ikkinchi qo'l do'konlaridan olardi. HOZIR: ancha nozikroq va nafis dizayner kiyimlarida chiroyli ko'rinadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'much slimmer' - 'much' qiyosiy darajani
kuchaytiradi ('very slimmer' XATO).
⚠ 'plump' - 8-betdagi jadvalda ham bor edi.

tasks.en: EATING HABITS - THEN: she liked eating chips and chocolate. NOW: she is constantly on a diet.
tasks.uz: OVQATLANISH ODATI - O'ShA PAYT: kartoshka fri va shokolad yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardi. HOZIR: doim parhezda.

tasks.en: FREE-TIME ACTIVITIES - THEN: she used to sing in the college choir, go for walks on the beach and listen to the radio; she didn't use to go to clubs. NOW: she goes to the gym every day and enjoys going to the theatre or to parties.
tasks.uz: BO'SH VAQT - O'ShA PAYT: kollej xorida kuylardi, plyajda sayr qilardi va radio tinglardi; klublarga bormasdi. HOZIR: har kuni sport zaliga boradi, teatrga va bazmlarga borishni yoqtiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to go for a walk' = sayr qilmoq.
⚠ 'a choir' - /ˈkwaɪə/ deb o'qiladi.
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

tasks.en: Liza used to work as a cleaner, but now she is a successful singer.
tasks.uz: Liza ilgari farrosh bo'lib ishlardi, hozir esa muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi.
tasks.note:
⚠ GAPIRISh QOLIPI: 'used to' + fe'l,
but now + present simple.

⚠ Har mavzu uchun shunday bitta gap tuzing.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in how, how long or how far, then listen and check. Finally, in pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: how, how long yoki how far ni qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Nihoyat, juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh XIL 'HOW' SAVOLI.

  HOW FAR ...?   - MASOFA
     'How far is your office?'
     - 'It's 40 kilometres.'

  HOW ...?       - USUL (qanday)
     'How do you get there?'
     - 'I go by bus.'

  HOW LONG ...?  - VAQT
     'How long does it take?'
     - 'It takes nearly an hour.'

  ⚠ Javobga qarab savolni topish oson:
     kilometr → how far
     avtobus  → how
     soat     → how long


⚠ 'IT TAKES' - VAQT UChUN:

  'It takes an hour to get there.'
  = U yerga borish bir soat oladi.

  ⚠ Ega HAR DOIM 'it'.
  ⚠ Qolip: It takes + (kim) + VAQT +
     to + FE'L
     'It takes me twenty minutes to walk
      to school.'


⚠ 'GET THERE' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  'How do you get THERE?'
  ⚠ 'get to there' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'there', 'here', 'home' oldidan
  'to' QO'YILMAYDI.

  ⚠ Lekin joy nomi bilan 'to' kerak:
  'How do you get TO school?'


⚠ 'NEARLY AN HOUR':

  ⚠ 'an hour' - 'h' O'QILMAYDI, shuning
  uchun 'AN' artikli ('a hour' XATO).
  ⚠ 'nearly' = deyarli.


⚠ "I DON'T MIND":

  = qarshi emasman, parvo qilmayman.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda ham bor edi.


QO'ShIMChA KO'RSATMALAR (dialog
qurish uchun):

  • your school; 4 kilometres; by bike;
    about 10 minutes; good exercise and
    I enjoy it
  • the supermarket; 15 kilometres;
    by car; 20 minutes; quite fast
    because the roads are usually quiet
  • the seaside; 40 kilometres; by train;
    30 minutes; quick, so I often go at
    weekends
  • the park; 2 kilometres; on foot;
    20 minutes; a pleasant walk, so I go
    every day

  ⚠ 'ON FOOT' - 'by foot' XATO!

⚠ Javobda KILOMETR aytilgan - demak MASOFA
so'ralgan.
⚠ 'far FROM' - predlog 'from'.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Javobda TRANSPORT aytilgan - demak USUL

⚠ 'get THERE' - predlogsiz.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Javobda SOAT aytilgan - demak VAQT so'ralgan.
⚠ 'It takes' - ega har doim 'it'.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatma to'rtta ma'lumot beradi:
  joy; masofa; transport; vaqt; izoh.

  ⚠ Ularni 15-mashqdagi dialog qolipiga
  joylashtiring.

tasks.en: In pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
tasks.uz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.

tasks.en: A: How far is your school from your house? B: It's 4 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: I go by bike. A: How long does it take? B: About 10 minutes. It's good exercise and I enjoy it.
tasks.uz: A: Maktabing uyingdan qancha uzoqlikda? B: 4 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Velosipedda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: Taxminan 10 daqiqa. Yaxshi mashq va menga yoqadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'BY bike' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDIGAN:
'good exercise' ('a good exercise' emas).

tasks.en: A: How far is the supermarket? B: It's 15 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: By car. A: How long does it take? B: 20 minutes. It's quite fast because the roads are usually quiet.
tasks.uz: A: Supermarket qancha uzoqlikda? B: 15 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Mashinada. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 20 daqiqa. Ancha tez, chunki yo'llar odatda bo'sh.
tasks.note:

⚠ 'quiet' (jim, bo'sh) va 'quite' (ancha) -
ADAShTIRMANG! Imlosi juda o'xshash.

tasks.uz: A: Dengiz bo'yi qancha uzoqlikda? B: 40 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Poyezdda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 30 daqiqa. Tez, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari tez-tez boraman.

⚠ 'the seaside' - HAR DOIM 'the' bilan.
⚠ 'at weekends' - Britaniya varianti
(AQShda 'on weekends').

tasks.en: A: How far is the park? B: It's 2 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: On foot. A: How long does it take? B: 20 minutes. It's a pleasant walk, so I go every day.
tasks.uz: A: Bog' qancha uzoqlikda? B: 2 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Piyoda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 20 daqiqa. Yoqimli sayr, shuning uchun har kuni boraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'ON FOOT' - 'by foot' XATO!
Bu YAGONA istisno: qolgan hamma transport
'by' bilan.
⚠ 'pleasant' = yoqimli; 'plea-' /plez/ deb
o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: So - Neither/Nor
exercises.instructionUz: So - Neither/Nor
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - UCh QOIDA.


1) TASDIQ GAPGA ROZILIK:

   SO + yordamchi fe'l + ega

   A: I always walk to work.
   B: So do I.

   ⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: fe'l EGADAN
   OLDIN. Bu - 'inversion'.
   ⚠ 'So I do' - XATO!


2) INKOR GAPGA ROZILIK:

   NEITHER/NOR + yordamchi fe'l + ega

   A: I don't have cereal for breakfast.
   B: Neither/Nor do I.

   ⚠ 'neither' va 'nor' - bir xil ma'no.
   ⚠ Ular O'ZI INKOR ma'noli, shuning
   uchun fe'l TASDIQ shaklda:
   'Neither do I' ('Neither don't I' XATO).

   ⚠ 'neither' ikki xil o'qiladi:
   /ˈnaɪðə/ (Britaniya) yoki
   /ˈniːðə/ (AQSh).


3) ROZI BO'LMASLIK:

   ega + yordamchi fe'l (ODDIY tartib)

   A: I never drink coffee.
   B: Oh, really? I do.

   A: I often go to the cinema.
   B: I don't.

   ⚠ Bu yerda so'z tartibi ODDIY:
   avval EGA, keyin fe'l.


⚠ QAYSI YoRDAMChI FE'LNI OLISh:

  Gapdagi FE'LGA qarab:

  'I walk ...'        → So do I.
  'I am tired.'       → So am I.
  'I can swim.'       → So can I.
  'I have finished.'  → So have I.
  'I went there.'     → So did I.

  ⚠ Oddiy fe'l bo'lsa 'do/does/did'.


⚠ QISQA JADVAL:

  Tasdiq + rozi     → So + fe'l + ega
  Inkor  + rozi     → Neither/Nor + fe'l + ega
  Tasdiq + rozi emas → ega + fe'l (inkor)
  Inkor  + rozi emas → ega + fe'l (tasdiq)


⚠ 'ME TOO' va 'ME NEITHER':

  So'zlashuv nutqida osonroq varianti:
     'I like pizza.'   - 'Me too.'
     'I don't like it.' - 'Me neither.'

  ⚠ Lekin yozma va rasmiy nutqda
  'So do I' / 'Neither do I' to'g'riroq.

tasks.en: So - Neither/Nor
tasks.uz: So - Neither/Nor

tasks.en: We use so + auxiliary verb + subject to agree with an affirmative statement. A: I always walk to work. B: So do I.
tasks.uz: Tasdiq gapga rozilik bildirish uchun 'so' + yordamchi fe'l + ega ishlatiladi. A: Men doim ishga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham.
tasks.note:
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: fe'l EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ 'So I do' - XATO!

⚠ 'an auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l.

tasks.en: We use neither/nor + auxiliary verb + subject to agree with a negative statement. A: I don't have cereal for breakfast. B: Neither/Nor do I.
tasks.uz: Inkor gapga rozilik bildirish uchun 'neither/nor' + yordamchi fe'l + ega ishlatiladi. A: Men nonushtaga bo'tqa yemayman. B: Men ham.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'neither' O'ZI INKOR ma'noli - fe'l TASDIQ
shaklda: 'Neither DO I'.
⚠ 'Neither don't I' - XATO.

⚠ 'cereal' = don mahsulotidan nonushta.

tasks.en: We use subject + auxiliary verb to disagree with what someone says. A: I never drink coffee. B: Oh, really? I do.
tasks.uz: Kimnidir gapiga rozi bo'lmaslik uchun ega + yordamchi fe'l ishlatiladi. A: Men hech qachon qahva ichmayman. B: Rostdanmi? Men ichaman.
tasks.note:
⚠ Bu yerda so'z tartibi ODDIY: avval EGA.

⚠ 'Oh, really?' - hayratni bildiradi va
javobni yumshatadi.

tasks.en: A: I often go to the cinema. B: I don't.
tasks.uz: A: Men ko'pincha kinoga boraman. B: Men bormayman.
tasks.note:
⚠ Tasdiqqa rozi bo'lmaslik - INKOR yordamchi
fe'l bilan.

⚠ 'to the cinema' - 'THE' bilan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words, then listen and check. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Yetishmayotgan so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Keyin juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT DIALOG - TO'RT HOLAT.

  1  TASDIQ + ROZI    → So do I.
  2  INKOR  + ROZI    → Neither/Nor do I.
  3  INKOR  + ROZI EMAS → I do.
  4  TASDIQ + ROZI EMAS → I don't.

  ⚠ Kitob to'rt holatni ham AYNAN
  bir marta beradi - bu ataylab.


⚠ 3 va 4-BANDLARDAGI FARQ:

  3: A INKOR gapiradi ('I never make
     my bed'), B esa QILADI → 'I DO.'
  4: A TASDIQ gapiradi ('I often go
     fishing'), B esa QILMAYDI →
     'I DON'T.'

  ⚠ Ya'ni rozi bo'lmaslikda javob
  gapning TESKARISI bo'ladi.


QO'ShIMChA KO'RSATMALAR:

  • walk to school
  • go to the gym in my free time
  • visit friends after school
  • do the housework at weekends

  ⚠ Ular bilan ham to'rt xil dialog
  tuzish mumkin.


⚠ 'DRIVE TO WORK':

  = mashinada ishga bormoq.
  ⚠ 'to drive' - o'zi mashina haydash.
  ⚠ 'go BY car' - shunchaki mashinada
  borish (haydovchi boshqa bo'lishi ham
  mumkin).

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQ gapga rozilik → SO + fe'l + ega.
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: 'So DO I'.

⚠ INKOR gapga rozilik → NEITHER/NOR + fe'l + ega.
⚠ 'Nor do I' ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Fe'l TASDIQ shaklda: 'Neither DO I'.

⚠ INKORGA ROZI BO'LMASLIK → TASDIQ yordamchi
fe'l: 'I DO.'

⚠ So'z tartibi ODDIY: avval EGA.

tasks.promptUz: Men bormayman. Baliq oviga borishni yomon ko'raman.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQQA ROZI BO'LMASLIK → INKOR yordamchi
fe'l: "I DON'T."

⚠ 'hate' dan keyin -ING: 'hate GOING'.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT KO'RSATMA - TO'RT YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatma bilan to'rt xil javob
  berish mumkin:
     So do I. / Neither do I. /
     I do. / I don't.

  ⚠ Qaysi javob to'g'ri ekani A ning
  gapi TASDIQ yoki INKOR bo'lishiga
  bog'liq.

tasks.en: In pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.
tasks.uz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.

tasks.en: A: I always walk to school. B: So do I. / I don't. I go by bus.
tasks.uz: A: Men doim maktabga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham. / Men bormayman. Avtobusda boraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ TASDIQ gap: rozilik 'So do I', rozi emaslik
"I don't".

⚠ 'walk TO school' - artiklsiz.

tasks.uz: A: Bo'sh vaqtimda hech qachon sport zaliga bormayman. B: Men ham. / Men boraman. Haftada ikki marta boraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ INKOR gap: rozilik 'Neither do I', rozi
emaslik 'I do'.

⚠ 'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta.

tasks.en: A: I often visit friends after school. B: So do I. / I don't. I have to do my homework.
tasks.uz: A: Men ko'pincha darsdan keyin do'stlarimni yo'qlayman. B: Men ham. / Men yo'qlamayman. Uy vazifamni bajarishim kerak.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'after school' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'have to' = majbur bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: A: I don't do the housework at weekends. B: Neither do I. / I do. I help my mother.
tasks.uz: A: Men dam olish kunlari uy yumushini qilmayman. B: Men ham. / Men qilaman. Onamga yordam beraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'do the housework' - 'make' EMAS.
⚠ 'at weekends' - Britaniya varianti.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the phrases in the list to complete the dialogues below: I don't - Nor do I - I do - So do I.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan quyidagi dialoglarni to'ldiring: I don't - Nor do I - I do - So do I.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROZILIK / NOROZILIK (coursebook
  15-bet 'So - Neither/Nor').

  ROZILIK (men ham):
    tasdiqqa: SO do I
      'I always do my homework.' -
      'So do I.' = Men ham.
    inkorga: NOR do I / Neither do I
      'I never watch TV.' - 'Nor do
      I.' = Men ham (ko'rmayman).

  NOROZILIK (men esa yo'q/ha):
    tasdiqqa: I DON'T
      'I often go to the cinema.' -
      'I don't.' = Men esa bormayman.
    inkorga: I DO
      'I never tidy my room.' -
      'I do.' = Men esa yig'ishtiraman.


⚠ 'NEVER' = INKOR:

  'I never ...' inkor gap →
  rozilik 'Nor do I', norozilik
  'I do'.


⚠ KALIT - KEYINGI GAP:

  1 'it doesn't take a long time' →
    yig'ishtiradi → I DO (norozi)
  4 'I hate going to the cinema' →
    bormaydi → I DON'T (norozi)
  2, 3 - davomi yo'q → rozilik:
    So do I / Nor do I.


⚠ 'TO TIDY':

  = yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga
  keltirmoq.


⚠ 'IT DOESN'T TAKE A LONG TIME':

  = ko'p vaqt olmaydi. 'take' =
  (vaqt) olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the Photo File section and complete Steve's letter to his new pen-friend.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limiga qarang va Stivning yangi qalamkash do'stiga yozgan xatini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
YaNGI QALAMKASh DO'STGA XAT.

  ⚠ Xatning boshi Photo File bo'limida
  (kitob oxirida) berilgan - siz uni
  DAVOM ETTIRASIZ.


XATDA NIMA BO'LIShI KERAK
(unit mavzusiga qarab):

  1) Salomlashuv va tanishtirish
     'Dear ..., Thanks for your letter.
      Let me tell you about myself.'

  2) KUNDALIK TARTIB (unitning asosiy
     mavzusi)
     'I usually get up at ...
      Then I ...
      I go to school from ... till ...'

  3) MAKTAB JADVALI
     'On Mondays I have Maths, Geography
      and History.'

  4) BO'Sh VAQT
     'In my free time I ...
      I often ... but I never ...'

  5) Yakun va savol
     'What about you? Write soon.'

  Best wishes,
  Steve


⚠ QANDAY GRAMMATIKA IShLATILADI:

  • PRESENT SIMPLE - kundalik tartib
  • TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - always,
    usually, often, sometimes, never
  • VAQT PREDLOGLARI - at 7 o'clock,
    in the morning, on Mondays,
    from ... till ...

  ⚠ Ya'ni butun unitning grammatikasi
  shu xatda ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'BEST WISHES' va 'LOVE':

  Best wishes, - do'stlarga, yangi
     tanishlarga
  Love, - juda yaqin odamlarga

  ⚠ Yangi qalamkash do'stga
  'Best wishes' to'g'riroq.

tasks.en:
Dear Kim,

Thanks for your letter. Let me tell you about a typical day in my life.
tasks.uz:
Hurmatli Kim,

Xatingiz uchun rahmat. Hayotimdagi odatiy kun haqida gapirib beray.
tasks.note:
⚠ Murojaatdan keyin VERGUL.
⚠ 'Let me tell you about ...' - mavzuni
boshlash qolipi.

tasks.en: I usually get up at seven o'clock. I have a shower, then I have breakfast with my family. I leave the house at half past seven and walk to school.
tasks.uz: Odatda soat yettida turaman. Dush qabul qilaman, keyin oilam bilan nonushta qilaman. Yetti yarimda uydan chiqaman va maktabga piyoda boraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE + takrorlanish ravishi.
⚠ 'AT seven o'clock' - aniq soat.
⚠ 'half past seven' = 7:30.

tasks.en: Lessons start at eight o'clock. On Mondays I have Maths, English and History. My favourite subject is History.
tasks.uz: Darslar soat sakkizda boshlanadi. Dushanba kunlari matematika, ingliz tili va tarix bor. Sevimli fanim - tarix.
tasks.note:
⚠ Fan nomlari KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'On MondayS' - ko'plik 'har dushanba'
ma'nosini beradi.

tasks.en: I get home at about four o'clock and have lunch. After that, I always do my homework.
tasks.uz: Taxminan to'rtlarda uyga yetib boraman va tushlik qilaman. Shundan keyin har doim uy vazifamni bajaraman.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'get home' - predlogsiz.
⚠ 'about four o'clock' = to'rtlar chamasi.

tasks.en: In my free time I often play football with my friends. I sometimes read books, but I never watch TV in the evening.
tasks.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda ko'pincha do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman. Ba'zan kitob o'qiyman, lekin kechqurun hech qachon televizor ko'rmayman.
tasks.note:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN.
⚠ 'play football' - artiklsiz.

tasks.en:
I have dinner at eight o'clock and go to bed at half past ten. What about you? What is your daily routine like? Write soon.

Best wishes,
Steve
tasks.uz:
Soat sakkizda kechki ovqat qilaman va o'n yarimda uxlagani yotaman. Sizchi? Kundalik tartibingiz qanday? Tezroq yozing.

Eng ezgu tilaklar bilan,
Stiv
tasks.note:
⚠ 'What about you?' - suhbatni davom ettirish.
⚠ 'Best wishes,' - do'stlarga va yangi
tanishlarga.
⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

sections.title: Writing (an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (odamning turmush tarzi va uning o'zgarishi haqida maqola)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Odamning turmush tarzi va uning qanday o'zgargani haqida maqola yozganda, uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - MAQOLA QOIDASI.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     TO'LIQ ISM, qayerdan, kasbi
     ('what he/she does for a living')

  2-xatboshi:
     hayoti ILGARI qanday bo'lgan:
     uy, tashqi qiyofa, ovqatlanish
     odati, bo'sh vaqt

  3-xatboshi:
     BUGUNGI turmush tarzi

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     o'zgarishlar haqida NIMA HIS
     QILADI


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  'used to' yoki PAST SIMPLE →
     o'tmishdagi odatlar
  PRESENT TENSES →
     bugungi turmush tarzi

  ⚠ Bu 16-betdagi Liza haqidagi
  maqolaning AYNAN tuzilishi -
  shuning uchun 29-mashqda 'Use the
  text in Ex. 23 as a model' deyilgan.


⚠ 'TO DO SOMETHING FOR A LIVING':

  = tirikchilik uchun biror ish qilmoq.
  'What does he do for a living?'
  = uning kasbi nima?

  ⚠ 'What does he do?' bilan bir xil,
  lekin rasmiyroq.


⚠ 'NOWADAYS':

  = hozirgi kunda.
  ⚠ BITTA so'z, oxirida -S bor.
  ⚠ 'now a days' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW IT HAS CHANGED':

  PRESENT PERFECT - o'tmishdagi ish,
  natijasi hozir ko'rinadi.
  ⚠ Bu 7-unitning mavzusi.

tasks.en: When we write an article about someone's lifestyle and how it has changed, we can divide it into four paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Odamning turmush tarzi va uning qanday o'zgargani haqida maqola yozganda, uni to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we write his/her full name, where he/she comes from and what he/she does for a living.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida uning to'liq ismini, qayerdanligini va kasbini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to do sth FOR A LIVING' = tirikchilik uchun
ishlamoq.

⚠ 16-betdagi C xatboshisi aynan shunday edi.

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we write how his/her life used to be years ago. We write about his/her home, appearance, eating habits and free-time activities.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida uning hayoti yillar oldin qanday bo'lganini yozamiz: uyi, tashqi qiyofasi, ovqatlanish odati va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari.
tasks.note:
⚠ To'rt mavzu - 28-mashqdagi jadvalning
to'rt qatori bilan AYNI.

⚠ 'used to be' - o'tmishdagi holat.

tasks.en: In the third paragraph, we write about his/her lifestyle nowadays.
tasks.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida uning hozirgi turmush tarzi haqida yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'nowadays' = hozirgi kunda. BITTA so'z,
oxirida -S.

⚠ Zamon: PRESENT SIMPLE.

tasks.en: In the last paragraph, we write how he/she feels about these changes.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida u bu o'zgarishlarni qanday his qilishini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to feel ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'.

⚠ 16-betdagi B xatboshisi aynan shunday edi:
Lizaning fikri va iqtibos.

tasks.en: We use used to or the past simple to talk about the person's past habits, and present tenses to talk about his/her lifestyle nowadays.
tasks.uz: Odamning o'tmishdagi odatlari haqida 'used to' yoki past simple, hozirgi turmush tarzi haqida hozirgi zamonlarni ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ Zamonlarni ARALAShTIRMANG: o'tmish qismi
butunlay past, hozirgi qismi butunlay present.

exercises.instructionEn: You have been asked to write a magazine article about Bill Newton. Use the information from Ex. 28, and the plan below, to write your article (100 - 150 words). Use the text in Ex. 23 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizdan Bill Nyuton haqida jurnal maqolasini yozish so'ralgan. 28-mashqdagi ma'lumot va quyidagi rejadan foydalanib maqola yozing (100 - 150 so'z). 23-mashqdagi matnni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: 'Bill Newton is Britain's
        most successful film star.
        However, things were not always
        easy for the boy from Bristol.'

  MAIN BODY
     Para 2: past lifestyle
     Para 3: present lifestyle

  CONCLUSION
     Para 4: "Bill's life has changed a
        lot since those days in Bristol.
        'I enjoy my success and hope it
        will continue for many years to
        come,' he says."

  ⚠ Kirish va xulosa GAPLARI kitobda
  BERILGAN - siz faqat 2 va 3-xatboshini
  yozasiz.


⚠ REJADAGI GAPLARNI TAHLIL QILING:

  "Britain's most successful film star"
  ⚠ 'Britain's' - EGALIK apostrofi.
  ⚠ 'the most successful' - eng yuqori
  daraja, lekin egalikdan keyin 'the'
  TUShADI.

  'However, things were not always easy'
  ⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik
  bog'lovchisi, 16-betdagi maqolada
  ham xuddi shu joyda edi.

  'has changed a lot SINCE those days'
  ⚠ PRESENT PERFECT + since.

  'for many years to come'
  ⚠ = kelajakdagi ko'p yillar davomida.


⚠ HAJM: 100-150 SO'Z

  To'rt xatboshi uchun - har biri
  2-4 gap.


⚠ 'A MAGAZINE ARTICLE':

  = jurnal maqolasi.
  ⚠ 'a magazine' - jurnal;
  'a journal' - ilmiy jurnal, kundalik.

tasks.en: Bill Newton is Britain's most successful film star. However, things were not always easy for the boy from Bristol.
tasks.uz: Bill Nyuton - Britaniyaning eng muvaffaqiyatli kino yulduzi. Ammo Bristollik bu bola uchun hammasi ham oson bo'lmagan.
tasks.note:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ "Britain's" - egalik apostrofi.
⚠ 'However' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi.

tasks.en: Bill used to live in a flat in the middle of Bristol. He had long hair and he was quite plump. He used to wear blue jeans. He liked eating hamburgers and chips. In his free time he used to play football, go to the cinema and go to rock concerts.
tasks.uz: Bill Bristol markazidagi kvartirada yashardi. Uning sochi uzun edi va ancha to'ladan kelgandi. Ko'k jinsi kiyardi. Gamburger va kartoshka fri yeyishni yaxshi ko'rardi. Bo'sh vaqtida futbol o'ynar, kinoga va rok konsertlariga borardi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 28-mashqdagi jadvalning ChAP ustuni.
⚠ 'used to' + past simple aralash ishlatiladi -
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

⚠ Aniq so'zlar AUDIODAN tasdiqlanadi.

tasks.en: Today, Bill lives in a large house with a garden in the countryside. He is slim and handsome, with short hair, and he wears expensive suits. He eats fish, salads and drinks orange juice. He enjoys going to parties, nightclubs and the theatre.
tasks.uz: Bugun Bill qishloq joyda bog'li katta uyda yashaydi. U nozik va kelishgan, sochi kalta, qimmat kostyum kiyadi. Baliq, salat yeydi va apelsin sharbati ichadi. Bazmlarga, tungi klublarga va teatrga borishni yoqtiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 28-mashqdagi jadvalning O'NG ustuni.
⚠ Zamon: PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.

tasks.en: Bill's life has changed a lot since those days in Bristol. "I enjoy my success and hope it will continue for many years to come," he says.
tasks.uz: Billning hayoti Bristoldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi. "Muvaffaqiyatimdan zavqlanaman va u yana ko'p yillar davom etishiga umid qilaman", - deydi u.
tasks.note:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ 'has changed ... since' - PRESENT PERFECT.
⚠ 'for many years to come' = kelajakdagi ko'p
yillar davomida.

Dear Laura,

My name is Aziz Karimov and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I am fourteen years old and I am tall and slim with brown eyes and short dark hair.

There are five of us in our family; my parents Bobur and Nilufar, my brother Timur, aged ten, my sister Malika, aged seven, and me. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. They're kind and very friendly. My brother is funny, but he can be a bit noisy sometimes.

Well, that's all about me. I hope you like the picture of my family. Write back soon and tell me about yourself.

Best wishes,
Aziz

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - He lives long who lives well. As you make your bed, so you must lie upon it.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Yaxshi yashagan uzoq yashaydi. To'shagingni qanday solsang, shunga yotasan.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL.


1) 'HE LIVES LONG WHO LIVES WELL.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Yaxshi yashagan odam
  uzoq yashaydi.'

  MA'NOSI: Umrning uzunligi YILLAR
  soni bilan emas, MAZMUNI bilan
  o'lchanadi. Yaxshi, foydali yashagan
  odamning umri to'la hisoblanadi.

  ⚠ SO'Z TARTIBI ESKI:
  'He lives long WHO lives well.'
  = 'The person who lives well lives
     long.'
  ⚠ Zamonaviy inglizchada bunday
  yozilmaydi - bu maqol qadimiy.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Umr uzunligi bilan
  emas, mazmuni bilan qadrli.'


2) 'AS YOU MAKE YOUR BED, SO YOU MUST
   LIE UPON IT.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'To'shagingni qanday
  solsang, shunga yotishing kerak.'

  MA'NOSI: Har kim o'z qilmishining
  oqibatini o'zi ko'radi.

  ⚠ 'to make the bed' = to'shakni
  yig'moq/solmoq - 14-betdagi
  13-mashqda ham bor edi!

  ⚠ 'to lie' = yotmoq
     lie - lay - lain (NOTO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ 'to lie' = yolg'on gapirmoq
     lie - lied - lied (TO'G'RI fe'l)
  ⚠ IKKI XIL 'lie' bor - adashtirmang!

  ⚠ 'upon' = 'on' ning ko'tarinki
  shakli (maqol va she'rlarda).

  ⚠ 'AS ... SO ...' - qadimiy qolip:
  'qanday ... shunday ...'

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Ekkaningni o'rasan.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit KUNDALIK TARTIB va TURMUSh
  TARZI haqida. Ikkala maqol ham
  odamning O'Z hayotini qanday
  quriishi haqida - unit mavzusiga
  to'g'ri keladi.
