wordFormation.explanationUz: Fe'l + zarracha butunlay yangi ma'no beradi. 9-mashqdagi iboralar.
Betdagi bir necha so'z uzun so'zning qisqartmasi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I [fe'l] ... every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have breakfast and do my homework every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har kuni nonushta qilaman va uy vazifamni bajaraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat.
⚠ 'every day' AJRATIB yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I like / don't like / hate / don't mind [-ING].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't mind doing the washing-up, but I hate doing the ironing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Idish yuvishga qarshi emasman, lekin dazmol qilishni yomon ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Bu fe'llardan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.
⚠ Kuchlilik: hate < don't like < don't mind <
like < love.

sentencePatterns.formula: Which picture shows [nima]? - Picture [harf].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Which picture shows a satellite? - Picture C.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qaysi surat sun'iy yo'ldoshni ko'rsatadi? - C surati.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Which' - CHEKLANGAN tanlovdan
('what' - cheksiz tanlovdan).

sentencePatterns.formula: There are two [son]-hour [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Each day there are two six-hour space walks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Har kuni ikkita olti soatlik kosmik sayr bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'six-hour' - DEFIS bilan va HOUR BIRLIKDA,
chunki u sifat vazifasida.
⚠ 'six-hours' - XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: First, ... Then, ... After that, ... Finally, ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: First, the crew wake up. Then they have breakfast. After that, they start work. Finally, they go to bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avval ekipaj uyg'onadi. Keyin nonushta qiladi. Shundan keyin ishni boshlaydi. Nihoyat, uxlagani yotadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari - kundalik tartibni
so'zlashning asosi.
⚠ Har biridan keyin VERGUL.

sentencePatterns.formula: They have a couple of hours to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have a couple of hours to wash and have breakfast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda yuvinish va nonushta qilish uchun bir-ikki soat bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'a couple OF' - 'of' ShART.
⚠ 'time TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: According to [manba], ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: According to NASA, the meals are tasty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: NASA ma'lumotiga ko'ra, taomlar mazali.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'according TO' - predlog 'to'.
⚠ 'according to me' - XATO! 'In my opinion'
deyiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's time for [kim] to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's time for the crew to go to bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ekipajning uxlash vaqti keldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Turg'un qolip: 'it's time for sb to do sth'.
⚠ 'go TO bed' - artiklsiz.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She [fe'l]-s at [soat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon soat 5:00 da uyg'onadi va dush qabul qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 3-shaxs birlik -S ni UNUTMANG.
⚠ 'AT' + aniq soat.

sentencePatterns.formula: I [ravish] [fe'l] ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I always make my bed in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har doim ertalab to'shagimni yig'aman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN.
⚠ Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN: 'She is always late.'

sentencePatterns.formula: What time does he have [fan]? - He has [fan] from ... till ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does Tom have Maths? - He has Maths from 9:10 till 10:00.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom matematikani soat nechada o'qiydi? - 9:10 dan 10:00 gacha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - ikkalasi ham ShART.

sentencePatterns.formula: How far is [joy]? - It's [son] kilometres.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How far is your office? - It's 40 kilometres.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Idorangiz qancha uzoqlikda? - 40 kilometr.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ MASOFA savoli.

sentencePatterns.formula: How long does it take? - It takes [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long does it take to get there? - It takes nearly an hour.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yerga borish qancha vaqt oladi? - Deyarli bir soat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ega HAR DOIM 'it'.
⚠ 'AN hour' - 'h' o'qilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I go by [transport]. / I go on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually go by bus. / I go to the park on foot.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda avtobusda boraman. / Bog'ga piyoda boraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BY' + transport, ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON foot' ('by foot' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: I used to [fe'l], but now I [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pauline used to have short orange hair, but now she's got long brown hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Polinaning sochi kalta va to'q sariq bo'lardi, hozir esa uzun va jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'used to' + ODDIY fe'l.
⚠ O'zgarishni ko'rsatishning eng qulay qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I didn't use to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I didn't use to have long hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening sochim uzun emas edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'didn't used to' - keng tarqalgan XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: Did you [fe'l] [vaqt]? - Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did you read a newspaper last Monday? - No, I didn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'tgan dushanba gazeta o'qidingmi? - Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'Did' dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: So + [yordamchi fe'l] + I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A: I always walk to work. B: So do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: A: Men doim ishga piyoda boraman. B: Men ham.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ TASDIQ gapga rozilik.
⚠ So'z tartibi TESKARI: 'So DO I'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Neither/Nor + [yordamchi fe'l] + I.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A: I don't have cereal for breakfast. B: Neither do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: A: Men nonushtaga bo'tqa yemayman. B: Men ham.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKOR gapga rozilik.
⚠ 'neither' o'zi inkor - fe'l TASDIQ shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: I do. / I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A: I never make my bed. B: Oh, really? I do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: A: Men hech qachon to'shagimni yig'maman. B: Rostdanmi? Men yig'aman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ROZI BO'LMASLIK - so'z tartibi ODDIY.
⚠ Javob gapning TESKARISI bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] used to [fe'l], but now he/she [fe'l]-s.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Liza used to work as a cleaner, but now she is a successful singer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Liza ilgari farrosh bo'lib ishlardi, hozir esa muvaffaqiyatli qo'shiqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ O'tmish va hozirni qiyoslashning asosiy qolipi.
⚠ 'work AS' - kasb oldidan 'as'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Where do you come from? - I come from [mamlakat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where do you come from? - I come from Italy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Siz qayerdansiz? - Men Italiyadanman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'from' HAR DOIM oxirida.
⚠ 'Where are you from?' bilan bir xil ma'no.

sentencePatterns.formula: What are you studying? / Where do you study?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are you studying? - Medicine. Where do you study? - At Glasgow University.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima o'qiyapsiz? - Tibbiyot. Qayerda o'qiysiz? - Glazgo universitetida.

sentencePatterns.formula: What are you doing this evening? - I'm [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What are you doing this evening? - I'm meeting some friends.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilasiz? - Do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI REJA → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

sentencePatterns.formula: He/She is much [qiyosiy sifat] now.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is much slimmer now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hozir ancha nozikroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'much' qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi.
⚠ 'very slimmer' - XATO ('very' faqat oddiy
sifat bilan).

sentencePatterns.formula: They used to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They used to wear sandals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular sandal kiyishardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ TASDIQ shakl: 'used to' + oddiy fe'l.

sentencePatterns.formula: They didn't use to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They didn't use to ride motorbikes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular mototsikl haydamasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKORDA 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ "didn't used to" - eng keng tarqalgan xato.

sentencePatterns.formula: Did he use to [fe'l]? - No, he didn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did Bill use to live in a large house? - No, he didn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill katta uyda yashaganmi? - Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA ham 'USE' - 'used' EMAS!
⚠ 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim]'s life has changed a lot since [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bill's life has changed a lot since those days in Bristol.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Billning hayoti Bristoldagi o'sha kunlardan beri ancha o'zgardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT + 'since' - o'zgarish natijasi
hozir ko'rinadi.
⚠ Maqolani yakunlashning tayyor qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time does X + FE'L? - He/She + FE'L-s at + VAQT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time does John wake up? - He wakes up at seven o'clock in the morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: John soat nechada uyg'onadi? - U ertalab soat yettida uyg'onadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Savol 'does', javob '-s'.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's [daqiqa] past/to [soat].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's a quarter to eleven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n birga chorak qoldi.

sentencePatterns.formula: His/Her [fan] lesson starts at ... and finishes at ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Her Maths lesson starts at nine o'clock and finishes at ten to ten.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning Matematika darsi soat to'qqizda boshlanib, o'nga o'n daqiqa qolganda tugaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Jadval - present simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + RAVISh + FE'L + ... + VAQT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Greg often goes fishing at weekends.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Greg dam olish kunlari tez-tez baliq oviga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Ravish asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN.

sentencePatterns.formula: I never + FE'L ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I never get up early on Sundays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'never' bilan 'don't' ISHLATILMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: She enjoys + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Cindy enjoys reading and going to the theatre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sindi o'qish va teatrga borishdan zavqlanadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'enjoy' dan keyin V-ing.

sentencePatterns.formula: X used to + FE'L ... Now X + FE'L-s ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sam used to drive a sports car. Now he rides a bicycle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sam ilgari sport mashina haydardi. Hozir u velosipedda yuradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ O'tgan odat vs hozirgi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Did X use to + FE'L? - No, he didn't. He used to ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did Robert use to have a car? - No, he didn't. He used to have a bicycle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Robertning mashinasi bormidi? - Yo'q. Uning velosipedi bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ So'roqda 'use to' ('d' siz).

sentencePatterns.formula: X usually + V-s, but yesterday/last ... X + V2.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually drive to work, but yesterday I took the bus.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men odatda ishga mashinada boraman, lekin kecha avtobusga chiqdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Odat (present) vs bir marta (past).

sentencePatterns.formula: A: I always/often ... - B: So do I. / I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I always do my homework. - So do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men har doim uy vazifamni qilaman. - Men ham.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Tasdiqqa rozilik 'So do I', norozilik 'I don't'.

sentencePatterns.formula: A: I never ... - B: Nor do I. / I do.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I never watch TV. - Nor do I.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon televizor ko'rmayman. - Men ham.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Inkorga rozilik 'Nor do I', norozilik 'I do'.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are [son] of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are four of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'We are four' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: X can be a bit [sifat] sometimes.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My sister can be a bit bossy sometimes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Opam ba'zan biroz buyruqboz bo'lishi mumkin.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Yumshoq tanqid.
